entry.name: VideoPath
entry.label: Absolute path to the video Fresco is currently showing as the desktop wallpaper.

entry.name: StillPath
entry.label: Absolute path to a still-image fallback (poster frame / photo wallpaper).

entry.name: PlayVideo
entry.label: Play VideoPath as a looping, muted video instead of showing StillPath.

entry.name: PauseMode
entry.label: Desktop only: pause the video while a window is fullscreen (0), fullscreen or maximized (1), or never (2).

entry.name: Dim
entry.label: Opacity (0-0.8) of the black veil drawn over the media, for prompt legibility.

entry.name: LayerDir
entry.label: Directory holding Fresco's widget-layer PNGs (layer-<connector>.png, layer.png).

entry.name: RefreshMs
entry.label: How often (ms) to re-check the widget-layer PNGs for a new frame.
